title: The observatory door
scope: Original illustration · timeline splits and travel between existing worlds
premise: Mira can open a new course of events at home, and she can visit a world that existed before she arrived. What is the difference?
ending: The new harbour timeline starts at the gate decision. Orchard already existed. Mira’s journeys connect these timelines; the journeys themselves do not create Orchard.

people.name: Mira
people.introduction: A traveller who can move between timelines.

events.title: Mira starts in Harbour
events.text: Harbour is the world Mira calls home. Its gates have always been closed.

events.title: Orchard already has an observatory
events.text: In another timeline, the people of Orchard built an observatory long before Mira visited. This timeline does not begin with her arrival.

events.title: The gate decision splits the course
events.text: Mira activates a device that lets both outcomes continue: a course with the gates closed, and a new branch with the gates open.

events.title: The new branch opens its gates
events.text: This timeline begins at the decision. From here, Harbour follows a different course.

events.title: The original course keeps its gates closed
events.text: The original Harbour timeline continues. Creating the new branch did not erase it.

events.title: Mira arrives at Orchard’s observatory
events.text: Mira leaves the original Harbour timeline and arrives in Orchard. She meets people whose lives were already under way.

events.title: Mira enters the new Harbour branch
events.text: Mira leaves Orchard and travels into the branch where the gates opened. That branch began at the decision, before this arrival.

guide.title: Follow the split and the journeys

sources.title: Original explanatory example
sources.locator: Written for the timeline diagram feature
sources.note: Invented to demonstrate the visual notation. This is not a claim about any film or television series.

flowchart.title: A split is different from a journey
flowchart.frame: Read down each lane. Only the stated before/after relationships are asserted; alignment does not synchronise the worlds.
flowchart.description: Grey lanes show each course of events. S1 creates a new Harbour timeline. T1 enters the pre-existing Orchard timeline, and T2 enters the Harbour branch after it has begun.

timelines.label: Harbour · original course
timelines.description: Exists before the decision and continues afterwards.

timelines.label: Harbour · new branch
timelines.description: Starts at S1, where the gates open.

timelines.label: Orchard · another world
timelines.description: Exists before Mira’s arrival at T1.
